title: phit
tagline: Regression, mixed models and probability distributions for PHP.
summary: phit is a PHP extension, written in Rust, for regression and mixed models, probability distributions and descriptive statistics. Models are written as R formulas (fit_lm, fit_glm, fit_lmer, fit_glmer, predict), and results are plain PHP arrays.

verify.note: This checks the command line. PHP-FPM can read other configuration files: check extension_loaded('phit') in a web request and restart FPM after installing.

vignettes.title: Predicting rent with a linear model
vignettes.summary: Fit monthly rent on floor area and bedrooms for 400 simulated flats, then predict with 95% prediction intervals.

vignettes.title: School effects with a mixed model
vignettes.summary: Estimate school random intercepts with fit_lmer and show them with their conditional uncertainty.

vignettes.title: Exploring the t distribution
vignettes.summary: Compare Student's t densities and tail probabilities with the normal as the degrees of freedom change.
